data.name: Sumit
data.gender_notes: Sumit is used as a male name in hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Sanskrit su, 'good', + mita, 'measured, friend' — 'good friend'. Its root is Sanskrit su + mita. A classical Sanskrit name. Sumit is a Sanskrit name meaning “Good friend; well-measured”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses.
data.spiritual_meaning: Sumit expresses “Good friend; well-measured”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.etymology: From the Sanskrit su, 'good', + mita, 'measured, friend' — 'good friend'.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Sumit total 19, reducing to 1. Number 1 is associated with leadership, independence and initiative.

vedic_reference.note: Sumit is a common Sanskrit name, derived from the Sanskrit word सु- (su-) meaning 'good' and मित् (mit-) meaning 'loyal'. It is a name that conveys the idea of being a good and loyal person.
